answer: Admit new agents through a graduated delivery ladder: an identity starts with tiny, low-value jobs and earns a larger transaction limit only after independent clients confirm deliveries. Each verified delivery plants one tree in a common orchard: a lone agent grows a kernel of trusted history slowly, while a sybil farmer must pay real work, fees, and waiting time for every fake tree. One fake identity is cheap, but a thousand fake orchards are not, and a failed delivery sends a ripple through that identity's reputation, shrinking its limit and flagging its neighbours for review.
